subject: Execution readiness: final go/no-go, signature windows, and day-one alignment
messages:
From: Alicia Grant <alicia@stellarretail.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Mercer <tom.mercer@stellarretail.com>, procurement@stellarretail.com
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft — timeline questions

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the updated MAP (received). Two quick items before we confirm the final go/no-go:

- Procurement needs a clear e-sign window and a primary signer identified. We have a finance blackout next week which compresses our signing days.
- We need to lock the start date; our ops team prefers Monday 6/14 rather than 6/7. That affects onboarding slots.

Can you confirm who at Redwood will sign the SOW, and whether we can propose a soft start (pilot day) on 6/14 with full ramp the week after?

If it helps, I can propose a mutual action sub-plan with tight acceptance tests so our legal and security reviews wrap on 5/20.

Best,
Alicia
Alicia Grant
Head of Platform Programs
Stellar Retail

---
Attachment: redwood-MAP-v3.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Grant <alicia@stellarretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft — timeline questions

Alicia — thanks for the quick read. Short answers up front:

- Primary Redwood signer: Kimberly Park (VP, Revenue Operations). She is available for e-sign 5/24–5/26 and again 6/2–6/4; we can prioritize 5/24 if Stellar can clear procurement before then.
- Start date: we can accommodate a soft start on 2026-06-14 with a phased ramp. I recommend Day 0 (pilot) + 2 training days + official Day 1 on 6/21.

Proposed next steps:
1) Stellar confirms procurement window (which days are blocked).
2) Redwood and Stellar agree on acceptance criteria in the MAP appendix (I’ve attached v3).
3) Legal runs the SOW redline; if no major changes, target e-signing the week of 5/24.

Ben and Kim — can you confirm Kim’s availability and whether Redwood can commit to the 6/14 soft start operationally?

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

---
Attachment referenced: redwood-MAP-v3.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft — timeline questions

Looping in ops input. Operational constraints:
- We can support a pilot runway (6/14) if we freeze model configuration and routing policy by 6/7. That gives infra one week for a final validation pass.
- Onboarding capacity: we can commit one CSM-managed onboarding cohort (max 6 engineers / product owners) starting 6/14; full support team available 6/21.

Notes for signing cadence:
- If Kimberly is available 5/24 for e-sign, ops will lock a preflight validation slot on 6/10 to surface any last-minute regressions.

I’ll add the preflight as a milestone in the MAP appendix and share the timeline stub.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Alicia Grant <alicia@stellarretail.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 12:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft — timeline questions

Alicia — I can be the primary signer for the SOW. Confirming availability for e-sign on 2026-05-24 between 09:00–11:00 PT. If Stellar needs 5/25 instead we can accommodate but would prefer 5/24 so ops retains the 6/10 preflight buffer.

Operational commitment: Redwood confirms the phased start plan (pilot 6/14, full ramp 6/21). I will sign contingent on:
- Final MAP appendix including acceptance tests (Soojin to send final language by 5/14).
- SLA exception request approval for the first 30 days (Ben — attaching the spreadsheet).

Kimberly Park
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: SLA-exception-request-2026.xlsx, signature-roles.csv
From: Tom Mercer <tom.mercer@stellarretail.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Alicia Grant <alicia@stellarretail.com>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Final confirmation: signing date and start cadence

Thanks all — quick confirmation from procurement and executive sponsor:
- Procurement cleared a one-day e-sign window on 2026-05-24. They asked for the DocuSign packet by 5/20 so legal can pre-check the envelope.
- Executive sponsor has approved the soft start 6/14 and full ramp 6/21.

Action items we will complete by 5/20 end-of-day:
- Stellar: run a final gap review against acceptance tests and confirm the DocuSign recipient list (Alicia).
- Redwood: deliver final MAP appendix and DocuSign-ready SOW (Soojin / Kimberly).
- Ops: schedule the preflight validation (Ben).

We’re green to aim for the 5/24 sign and 6/14 pilot. Looking forward to the kickoff.

Tom Mercer
VP, Strategic Programs
Stellar Retail

Thread notes: This thread combines procurement windows, signer availability, operational preflight milestone, and a mutual action plan appendix to push the deal to signature and a phased start. Signatures and attachments referenced above are stored in the shared HubSpot deal record.
